title: {{card}} statements
description: Statement accounting and payment evidence in {{currency}}. Linked evidence never changes ledger balances.
legacyOverpaid: This historical statement is overpaid. Its recorded total is preserved; new actions cannot increase the overpayment.
stale: Payment data changed. Refresh and review again.
savedRefreshFailed: Saved successfully, but the latest data could not be refreshed. Close and reopen to retry the refresh; do not submit the payment again.

empty.title: No statements recorded
empty.description: Add the card issuer’s statement totals before attributing payment evidence.

editor.description: Use the exact issuer amounts for {{card}} ({{currency}}).
editor.linkFloor: Active links require at least {{amount}} paid.
editor.baselineHelp: The paid total starts as statement-only evidence.

link.title: Link existing payment
link.description: Attribute a posted ledger row to this statement without changing transactions or account balances.
link.confirmRepayment: I confirm this ordinary transaction is a repayment to {{card}}, not a purchase, fee, withdrawal, or refund.
link.emptyDescription: Record a real transfer or use an eligible posted transaction, then refresh.

payment.title: Record card payment
payment.description: Create a real transfer and optional statement link atomically, or record statement-only evidence.
payment.statementOnlyDescription: Updates statement accounting from external evidence. No transaction or balance change is created.

review.title: Review before confirming
review.noBalanceImpact: This evidence link does not change transactions, account balances, or transaction history.
review.baselineEvidence: Add external statement evidence without creating a transaction.
review.noTransaction: Only the statement baseline and status will change.
review.realTransfer: Create a posted transfer and link it to this statement.
review.atomicTransfer: Both account balances, the transaction, and evidence link commit together or not at all.
review.negativeFundsWarning: The source account will have a negative balance. Confirm only if this overdraft is intended.
review.cardCreditWarning: The card will have a positive credit balance. Confirm only if this overpayment is intended.

confirm.deleteDescription: The statement will be removed. Voided evidence keeps immutable original IDs; active links must be unlinked first.
confirm.unlinkDescription: The evidence link will be voided and statement accounting will be reversed. The underlying transaction and balances will not change.

audit.linkNote: Linked existing repayment evidence after reviewed confirmation.
audit.paymentNote: Recorded reviewed card transfer and statement evidence.
audit.deleteNote: Deleted card statement after reviewed confirmation.
audit.unlinkNote: Voided payment evidence after reviewed confirmation.
